scope: JSDOM events and state, with actual deterministic solver reports through an asynchronous Worker API facade. Historical-version fixtures test storage only. Canvas is stubbed; no browser layout, actual Worker-thread scheduling, GPU pixels or FPS evidence.

tests.name: Two mounted study instances have local fields, unique labels and scoped CSS
Reading current parameters does not reset or advance the live laboratory vehicle
A complete A/B study runs two frozen requests and renders actual solver responses
Sweep configuration, archive export and imported-mode exit remain usable
Road-surface launch, ABS/TCS and wing comparisons are executable options in the same standard research panel
Channel, overlay, record switches and clear reset pointer series and units without waiting for another pointer event
Cancelling, closing and disposal stop workers and keep the active page intact
Historical fixtures remain readable and cannot overwrite or co-plot with a new model at the storage cap
Oversized old archives are protected before parsing and new session results remain exportable
